STEP 2 - Ruler: Stainless steel bowl, roughly 22 cm inner-rim diameter (seen from above, it is nearly circular and fills much of the frame). Area = 3.14 x (11)^2 ≈ 380 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: (1) diced cooked chicken breast, (2) dark red kidney beans (cooked).

STEP 4 - Area: Food covers a small central pile. Chicken ~12% of bowl area (~46 cm^2); kidney beans ~4% (~15 cm^2). Total food coverage ~16%.

STEP 5 - Volume: Chicken: 46 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 69 ml. Beans: 15 cm^2 x 1.2 cm ≈ 18 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Chicken 69 ml x 0.95 ≈ 66 g. Beans 18 ml x 0.9 ≈ 16 g (cooked beans are dense).

STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked chicken breast ≈ 165 kcal/100 g → 66 g ≈ 109 kcal. Cooked kidney beans ≈ 127 kcal/100 g → 16 g ≈ 20 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A small pile of diced chicken and a few beans in a large bowl, roughly 80 g total and about 130 kcal, is plausible for a small portion or a side component.
